decisions.decision: Call-outs to be capped at 10 hours per month in the RFP.

budget_items.topic: State earmark request for pump station upgrade
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A $300K sewer pump station upgrade request is on the Town Manager's State Earmark list, alongside other town items; Paula said it is not the ARPA funding.
budget_items.quote: the list consists of security upgrades at turkey hill elementary and the primary schools ($374.5k), marshall park ($250k), library exterior painting ($36k) and $300k for sewer pump stations.

budget_items.topic: Leominster connection fees under the Inter-municipal Agreement
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Leominster charges $1,000 per connection against $750 for Lunenburg; Leominster wants to raise its charge to $1,250.
budget_items.quote: currently, leominster charges $1,000 for connections, but only $750 to lunenburg.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Bill said Chapter 90 funding cannot be used, especially if the manholes on 2A are raised. No dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: manhole funding- bill stated they cannot use chapter 90 funding, especially if they want to raise the level of the manholes on 2a.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Bill asked to limit the parts and materials markup to 10%; rental equipment to be cost plus 10%. Percentages only, no dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: parts and materials - bill asked to limit the markup to 10%.

budget_items.topic: FY24 budget revision: expenditures, deficit and retained earnings
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Paula listed the changes to the FY24 budget: expenditures and indirect costs, the deficit, and retained earnings transfers to OPEB and Capital Reserve; the amount to appropriate from Retained Earnings is the figure published in the warrant.
budget_items.quote: changes to the budget are as follows: expenditures & indirect costs- $1,439,402.82, deficit-$218,690.42, retained earnings transfers- $1,000 to opeb and $36,621.37 to capital reserve.

budget_items.topic: FY24 Fitchburg usage and fringe benefit increases
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Paula added $6,600 to Fitchburg Usage and $8,631.53 to health insurance and retirement benefits; Fitchburg rates are expected to rise 7% per year for five years, against a 4% budgeted increase.
budget_items.quote: paula added $6,600 to fitchburg usage and $8,631.53 for health insurance/retirement benefits for barb.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Paula reported the balances of the retained earnings, reserve capacity, I/I fund and capital reserve accounts in response to Dave's question.
budget_items.quote: retained earnings - $2,329,780, reserve capacity-$ 28,023.32, i/i fund- $9,943.73 and capital reserves- $ 141,210.66.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Commission had submitted a request for $300K from ARPA funds, but John said it appears they will not receive any ARPA funds and the Town Manager did not want it listed in the FY23 budget.
budget_items.quote: the commission submitted a request for $300k from arpa funds.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The planned capital expense for FY22 was $78K, of which $15K has been spent so far.
budget_items.quote: paula noted the planned capital expense for fy22 was $78k and they have spent $15k of that money so far.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Al Packard's capital estimate is $35K for the current year, $96K for next year, and a projected $1.2 million total through FY38; a proposal shows an average of $100K per year.
budget_items.quote: his estimate is $35k for the current year, $96k for next year, etc. up to fy38 with a projection of $1.2 million total.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Paula built a worksheet of rate scenarios; the average residential unit bill is $181 and the average business unit bill is $1,786.
budget_items.quote: the average residential unit bill is $181 and for a business unit - $1,786.
